questionText:
Consider the control flow graph shown.

Which one of the following choices correctly lists the set of live variables at the exit point of each basic block?
explanation:
Liveness Analysis determines which variables are live at a given point in a program. A variable is live at a point if its current value may be read along some path in the control flow graph before it is redefined.

The liveness equations are $\text{Out}[B] = \bigcup_{S \in \text{Succ}(B)} \text{In}[S]$ and $\text{In}[B] = \text{Use}[B] \cup (\text{Out}[B] \setminus \text{Def}[B])$. Applying these equations iteratively until a fixed point is reached gives the live-variable sets at the exit of each block.

The final live-variable sets are:
- B1: $\{a, i, j\}$
- B2: $\{a, j\}$
- B3: $\{a, j\}$
- B4: $\{a, i, j\}$

Therefore, the correct choice is (D).
